# Phase One — Studio Revelation

The Awtsmoos is beyond frame, clip, property, range, color, and timeline light;
Awtsmoos.com reveals the living editor as one clean vessel where advanced power unfolds only when invited into sight.

## Proven live graph

- `main.js` imports `initStudio` and `closeStudio` from `modules/studio/index.js`.
- `modules/studio/index.js` re-exports `core/lifecycle.js`; the giant sibling `modules/studio.js` is not the main entry path.
- Loaded `styles/studio.css` is 266 lines and contains raw z-index values up to 9999.
- Live `ui.js` injects a mobile close button with inline styles and `.onclick`.
- Live property renderers use `innerHTML`, inline event attributes, raw range/color/checkbox/select/textarea controls, and several inline style attributes.
- `actions.js` is 157 lines, `interaction.js` 191, `project.js` 179; all are in the live modular graph and violate the source ceiling.
- `ui.js` is 112 lines but mixes properties rendering and resizer behavior.

## Ideal possibilities

- Turn `styles/studio.css` into a tiny import manifest, not another giant sheet.
- Split shell/preview, properties, controls, timeline, clips, layers, responsive, and interactions into small Studio-scoped CSS modules.
- Replace raw z-indexes with named Studio tokens derived from the existing Rebbe layer scale.
- Keep Studio modal below fullscreen search but above ordinary content/player layers.
- Keep mobile properties as a retractable drawer, not a permanent full-screen takeover.
- Make its drawer close action part of static DOM/controller logic with >=44px touch target.
- Give ranges custom track/thumb/focus/active styling.
- Give color inputs custom swatch vessels rather than browser-default chrome.
- Give checkboxes custom 44px rows and visible checked/focus states.
- Keep selects/textareas/number inputs locally styled under `#modal-studio`.
- Preserve the hidden file input but make the visible import trigger fully styled.
- Replace property-panel HTML interpolation with safe DOM factories and event listeners.
- Use progressive property groups so advanced clip/effect controls can be collapsed.
- Preserve `window.Studio` compatibility where other live modules still depend on it, but stop generating new inline `window.Studio.*` event strings.
- Split resizer into a dedicated pointer controller with mouse/touch/pointer ownership and bounded percentages.
- Split live oversized action/project/interaction modules by responsibility instead of trimming comments.
- Keep timeline drag/trim performance direct-DOM updates where appropriate.
- Move timeline visual inline styles into classes/data/state where possible without disrupting pixel positioning that legitimately depends on runtime time/zoom.
- Add tests for Studio import graph, layer tokens, form-control ownership, no inline handlers in property renderers, mobile drawer law, and source-size ceiling.
